lines: The big guns are silent. The rifles are not.
A Concord sniper saw a movement across the wire.
Five men hit by morning. Three Hegemony, two Concord.
The Hegemony aid post has two beds. One is taken.
When they fill, the badly hit wait on stretchers, in the mud.
And today, each side votes what to build.
Your soldier is your ballot. Link in bio.
